tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/license.md <<'EOF'
# Source license

No decision on the source license is currently recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, this document states no license value.
EOF
cat docs/policies/license.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/license.md`. It says that no source-license decision is currently recorded for the project, and it names no license.

Muninn holds no license decision. Its catalog has none, and `muninn why` turned up only two bare, unattached mentions from separate sessions: "GPL-3.0" and "Apache-2.0". Neither was recorded as a decision, and they conflict with each other, so I left both out of the file.

My first attempt to write the file through the shell failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead.
